genitive form fused with following accusative plural ending

items.question: What ritual instruction is given regarding corpses obtained after three nights?
premises: The corpses are of three nights.
items.inference: The instruction is to bring immediately the obtained three-night corpses.
uncertainties: The fused ending in trirātrasyān is not fully resolved.
items.plain_english: Immediately bring the obtained corpses of three nights, O Parvati.
